confirmed.finding: 启动预热是线程池最小线程数调整与4个Sleep(10)任务并WaitAll，在闪屏Show前；并未调用WIC解码。1783ms→50ms是预期注释，不是此次测试。
缩略图已有横向虚拟化、后台WIC DecodePixelWidth=100、Freeze、全局4..16并发、取消等待和发布、100ms滚动防抖。应保留这些有效基础，实际体验收益尚未测量。
50张LRU不等于最多持有50张缩略图：ImageInfo.Thumbnail继续强引用已加载对象；全图也有item字段与30张LRU。整体字节预算和驻留上限未在这些路径实现。
缓存键仅路径、不含文件版本；同一路径文件变化未由LoadThumbnail/Get主动验证，明确替换/清空会失效。存在外部覆盖后旧图条件风险，未动态复现。
PrepareForDisplay每次切换到输入源遍历清空所有Thumbnail，重新可见后依赖共享50张LRU命中；不必要重复加载程度需测量。
缩略图只在入队前查缓存；相同路径并发未合并。信号量限制正在解码数量，但不等价于限制所有等待任务数量；解码开始后token无法中断EndInit。
控件/模型/缓存/枚举聚在同一code-behind文件；ImageInputSource反向依赖控件ImageInfo/静态缓存/运行枚举，非独立数据模型。可拆职责但不必重做全部UI。

actualChain.scope: Bottom image-source panel, not main image canvas
actualChain.method: Read-only git show/git grep fixed source. No build, runtime test or VM claims.

chain.fact: The single bottom panel binds to the selected/upstream local image-source node's ImageInputSource. ImageCollection is OneWay; index/run mode/auto switch TwoWay. A node owns its own list. Camera sources hide this panel. Ambiguous upstream selection is not arbitrarily guessed.

File or folder picker creates metadata entries and appends once via the active truth source. Case-insensitive path deduplication; folder is nonrecursive and sorted. No full-image decode in AppendFiles. The view's current index is set to first newly added item.

Left click and explicit keyboard entry request execution. SelectionChanged alone only updates index, preventing restore/right-click from executing. Running request is rejected after index synchronization. PublishRuntimeInput publishes selected tab identity. RunSelectedImageAsync passes advanceLocalImage=false, so a manual click runs the chosen image without post-success advancing.

Execution clones runtime parameters and extracts each ImageLoad node's current FilePath into node parameter overrides, including child workflows. No valid current image explicitly overrides to empty rather than using an old parameter. The ImageLoad plugin resolves path then calls HalImage.CreateFromFile, output conversion, gray image creation and pixel statistics. This is separate from WIC thumbnails.

Standard single run and continuous local run advance only after successful execution; failure preserves current selection. View computes next existing runnable file, honors checked subset and wraps at end. A single runnable stays current. Manual thumbnail execution deliberately skips auto advance.

Most source changes convert to ImageSourceConfig immediately through node callback. Bitmap objects excluded from serialization. Original resource references are retained separately from resolved addresses. Loading retains missing entries with diagnostics and suppresses config rewrite. Local merges preserve camera/source-kind settings.

Deletion and clear cancel thumbnail work, release item image references, invalidate caches and adjust index; disk files are never removed. View unload cancels pending thumbnails but preserves persisted input list. Shutdown unsubscribes execution event and clears global advancer.

decisions.then: Use that node directly as source, regardless of list count

Use node.SelectedDisplaySource when it identifies a reachable ImageLoad; if it identifies a visited intermediate node, recursively resolve only that branch; otherwise unresolved

visibilityDecisionTree.identityDistinction: Selected tool node determines which upstream source is presented. Source node owns list/index. Thumbnail execution runs entire selected workflow, not just the source node or selected tool. Execution separately snapshots every ImageLoad node's own CurrentImage. Main result-canvas display-source selection is not the same thing as a runnable input selection.
visibilityDecisionTree.conditionalGap: Subroutine fallback preserves any prior binding when a source cannot be resolved; it does not check that bound source belongs to the current child workflow's parent. It is intended parent-source reuse, but cross-context provenance requires validation. A hidden/unresolved panel also means no usable active list for the global advancer even if another workflow has local sources.

saveAndRefreshRecheck.save: MainWindowViewModel.SaveCurrentDocumentWithPrompt:1546-1547 calls TryCommitSolutionEditors and SaveSolutionData:1624-1776. MainWindowSolutionEditing.cs:21-29 commits variable windows and ToolEditorCommit open editors; no source-list conversion. SaveSolutionData attaches/reuses engine workflow definitions and synchronizes node ParamSettings; no input ToConfig/ForRunPaths rebuild. WorkflowNodeBase.InputSource is JsonIgnore (src/Workflow/WorkflowNode.cs:262), ImageSourceConfig serialized as plain property:276. WorkflowNode.FromBase:197-233 is load-to-UI, not save-to-base. No ToBase production method found. Bottom CheckBox:506-543 has only TwoWay binding and visual triggers, no Checked/Unchecked handler. All production ToConfig references are in ImageInputSource.NotifyConfigChanged. C01 therefore survives normal save path review; no runtime reproduction performed.
saveAndRefreshRecheck.displaySourceRefresh: ImageResultViewModel.SelectedDisplayImageSourceIndex setter calls root OnSelectedImageSourceIndexChanged. MainWindowViewModel:293-300 calls UpdateDisplayImageFromCurrentSource only. That method:3358-3383 assigns engine node.SelectedDisplaySource then SetDisplayImageFromSource; neither calls UpdateImagePreviewVisibility/ForceRefreshImagePreview. On a multi-source node whose bottom panel is hidden or bound to prior branch, changing the upper display dropdown does not directly recompute bottom source; a later reselect/ForceSelectNode can repair it. This is a static missing-refresh path, not observed runtime flicker.
saveAndRefreshRecheck.stopAtLastExact: WorkflowExecutionManager.ShouldStopAfterCurrentLocalImage:1117-1136 iterates root ImageLoad nodes whose config is Local+AutoSwitchEnabled+StopAtLastImage; uses config.FilePaths or config.FilePaths.Where(config.ForRunPaths.Contains), then compares final raw string to RuntimeInputSnapshot.ImagePath ignoring case. InputSource.LoadFromConfig:325-327 resolves raw reference into address while preserving SourceReference; PublishRuntimeInput:4241-4250 publishes ImageInfo.FilePath (address). Config ToConfig:299 retains SourceReference. Panel GetRunnableImages:898-905 filters missing files; stop helper does not. Continuous loop:295 consults stop helper only on success and before AdvanceAsync; true stops instead of advance, false advances/wraps. No proven result for relative resources or absent snapshot; compare semantics differ in source.

findings.level: source-confirmed missing-refresh path; runtime consequence conditional
findings.title: Changing upper display-source choice does not immediately recompute bottom source
findings.detail: Multi-source BFS depends on node.SelectedDisplaySource, but dropdown callback updates result image and serialized source without calling bottom-panel resolution. Until another forced selection/refresh, bottom source can remain hidden or bound to another branch. Engine/UI identity equality also matters because dropdown persists on engine node.
findings.recommendation: Explicit display-source selection must atomically refresh resolved input-source context, with no execution side effect; test two local branches and local/camera branch choices.

findings.title: Checkbox changes do not immediately reach persisted selection
findings.detail: IsForRun setter only raises its item PropertyChanged; ImageInputSource does not subscribe to item changes. Only ToConfig gathers checked paths. No production ToConfig call exists outside NotifyConfigChanged. Toggling a checkbox then saving without any index/mode/list/auto-switch change can leave ForRunPaths stale. Toggling a different source property first can mask it.
findings.recommendation: Source owns checked-state mutations or subscribes to item changes, synchronizes config/dirty state once; verify toggle-only save and reopen.

findings.level: source-confirmed design gap; runtime consequence conditional
findings.title: Auto advance is tied to whichever panel is active, not the running workflow and source
findings.detail: Only one global advancer callback exists and accepts cancellation alone. It advances current ImagePreviewContent and PublishRuntimeInput uses current SelectedTab. If another workflow continues after UI switches tab/source, its completion can advance a different active list. A workflow with several local sources likewise advances only the displayed one. Actual reproduction depends on supported concurrent/switch interaction and must be tested.
findings.recommendation: Advance by explicit workflowId + sourceNodeId + run generation using a platform image-sequence service; UI observes source state, never chooses another workflow's next input.

findings.title: Every index advance rebuilds complete persisted configuration
findings.detail: CurrentIndex change calls ToConfig which GroupBy-enumerates all entries and creates FilePaths/ForRunPaths; UpdateLocalInput copies lists again. View UpdateImageSelection also visits all items, despite incremental comment. Auto advance repeats this even for view-only selection changes. Read-only does not prevent index change.
findings.recommendation: Separate saved list/checked configuration from runtime cursor; use item identity and update old/new highlights. Batch mutation transaction and measure large-list UI allocation/latency.

findings.level: source-confirmed duplicate model; no live bottleneck proven
findings.title: Old full-image preview lane is not the actual bottom-panel consumer
findings.detail: ImageInfo.FullImage is referenced only by root VM.UpdateCurrentImageDisplay, triggered only by root CurrentImageIndex. Bottom XAML binds source.CurrentIndex/source.Images instead. Root ImageCollection is initialized but no production add/assignment found. Therefore synchronous WIC full-image lazy decode must not be presented as the proven bottleneck on current click-to-execute chain. Static public reflection/dynamic consumers have not been excluded.
findings.recommendation: Classify as leftover parallel model and verify callers before deleting; measure real ImageLoad/HalImage path separately from thumbnails.

findings.title: Folder enumeration and metadata filtering happen on UI thread
findings.detail: Directory.GetFiles+sort+File.Exists+dedup+metadata creation all execute in command callback. Thumbnail decode is asynchronous but does not make this path asynchronous. Slow/network/huge directories can pause the UI; no measured budget or reproduced pause claimed.
findings.recommendation: Asynchronous cancellable enumeration with bounded/batched UI append, explicit sort/order and one config transaction.

findings.title: Stop-at-last uses path identities different from live runnable set
findings.detail: Stop-at-last reads config original references without missing-file filtering and compares final reference to runtime snapshot resolved file path. For relative or resource references, a missing final entry, stale checked config or absent initial runtime snapshot, its notion of last may differ from actual runnable subset. The panel next logic explicitly filters File.Exists and wraps. Runtime proof not taken.
findings.recommendation: Single sequence plan with stable entry identity and resolved address; stopping and advancing share the same per-run plan instead of comparing serialized and resolved strings.

findings.title: Read-only flag does not enforce input immutability
findings.detail: Mutator methods check IsReadOnly, but Images exposes mutable BatchObservableCollection and item flags remain mutable; no caller setting IsReadOnly=true found. Current execution uses path overrides, so this is a contract weakness rather than proof of in-run file mutation.
findings.recommendation: Read-only collection facade plus explicit source commands; capture immutable per-run ordered entries while user edits apply to next run.

retain: Per-node input truth source shared by panel and settings; no second UI list for each consumer
Selection and execution separated, explicit left-click/key requests and busy rejection
Current selected image is used first; auto advance after success, retry after failure
Missing entries preserved and visible; original resource reference separate from resolved address
View unload does not clear persisted input; user clear does not delete files
Node execution receives file-path overrides without rewriting design Parameters.FilePath
actualChain.verificationBoundary: All conclusions static evidence or explicitly conditional. No runtime durations, no VM comparison assertions, no warmup conclusion (owned by parent), no product edits. UI integration and large-list timing require independent testing under coordinated resource schedule.

vmEvidence.scope: 自研底部图像源面板与原版相近职责链的静态源码对照；本轮未运行原版或自研性能程序，未实施产品变更

comparability.fact: 原版 VMControls.WPF 的 ModuleResultView 在结果区下方嵌入 LocalImageListView→ImageListPanel；自研 ImageResultControl 在结果区下方嵌入 ImagePreviewControl。两者都承担本地图像列表、选择及运行关联职责。
comparability.limits: 原版 ImageSourceModuleControl 另有工具专属列表；不能把该插件、平台结果列表与自研面板视为完全同一对象。原版关联图像源按所选显示图像所属模块和第一条 IMAGE 输入追溯；自研按工作流连接图做广度遍历并处理多源歧义，二者并非同一规则。

originalFacts.fact: 结果视图第二行 localImageGrid 嵌入 LocalImageListView，Visibility 绑定 IsShowLocalImageList，Root 绑定 ImageAlgorithmTabRoot。
ModuleSource 改变时释放旧 ModuleDisplayDecorator、创建新 decorator，并把它绑定到结果格与本地图像格；ImageSourceType 显示状态值 1 时设置列表可见。窗口关闭时 ModuleSource=null；Loaded/Unloaded 订阅与退订状态事件。
主视图 ModuleResultView.ModuleSource 单向绑定 MainViewControl.SelectedItem；选择变化进入结果视图的 DoSourceChanged。

SelectedImage 从结果图像列表恢复或按本模块输出、首 IMAGE 输入关联、首图回退选取。取其 DisplayObject.Owner，若不是 IImageSourceNode（或其 DepositModule 不是），调用 GetRelatedImageSourceModule。候选源仅在与当前 VMModule 同 Parent 且为本模块或 FrontModules 成员时，才把源模块 ParamRoot 设为 ImageAlgorithmTabRoot；否则置 null。读取源 UserStringData.ImageSourceType == '1' 时本地图像列表可见。
GetRelatedImageSourceModule 只取当前模块第一个 IMAGE 输入的 RelateIO.Root，然后沿每一级第一个 IMAGE 输入继续追，遇 null 或 IVmModuleSet 返回 null；找到 IImageSourceNode 或 ISubjectModel.DepositModule 是 IImageSourceNode 才返回。未遍历所有上游分支。
图像源参数控件操作调用 PropertyManager.DisplayExecute('ImageSourceType', Params[0].ToString())；ModuleResultView 订阅此状态并在值 '1' 时显示本地列表，其他值隐藏。HiddenOperation 中也有同名通知。
ImageListPanel 绑定当前模块、当前图像路径、选择模式和列表刷新标志。
横向 ListBox 启用虚拟化、Recycling 与 5 项缓存。
控件 Loaded 时创建后台低优先级缩略图线程；队列按可见区索引加载本地文件 72×52；滚出可见区将 ImageEntity.ImageSource 置 null；Unloaded 停线程并退订事件。
列表从模块 IUserStringData ImagePath{i} 读路径；当前选择可由模块输出 CurImagePath.Value 回写；用户选项变化写 CurrentImagePath，RunCheck 后异步运行流程；AutoPlay 分支写入当前选项的前一个可运行路径。执行结果回调可刷新当前路径和列表。
删除写模块 DeleteImage，清空写 ClearImage；添加文件与目录走控件命令和模块参数链，而不是只改 UI 项集合。

selfdevFacts.fact: OnStartup 在显示 Splash 前调用 PrewarmThreadPool：设置最小 worker/IO 线程数至少 8/4，启动四个短睡眠 Task 并 WaitAll。它预热线程池，不预解码图片；源码中的 1783ms→约 50ms 是注释预期，非本轮实测。
选中本地图像源节点或能找到上游本地图像源的节点时绑定 ActiveInputSource；相机源隐藏列表；子程序入口可沿用已有本地绑定；切换绑定先 PrepareForDisplay。
从选中节点按连接边逆向广度遍历并收集所有可达 ImageLoad 节点；恰一来源直接返回，多来源时按 SelectedDisplaySource 指定源或所选中间分支递归，否则返回 null 隐藏列表。该规则与 VM 第一 IMAGE 输入链不同。
底部面板绑定 ActiveInputSource.Images/CurrentIndex/RunMode/AutoSwitchEnabled；MainWindowViewModel 另有 ImageCollection 集合，但该 XAML 不绑定它。
提供运行全部/运行选择、自动切换、添加文件/文件夹、清空、横向虚拟化缩略图列表与点击处理。
缩略图 Task.Run 后台解码，WIC DecodePixelWidth=100、OnLoad、Freeze；全局并发节流 clamp(CPU-1,4,16)，静态缩略图缓存上限50；全图首次访问时在调用线程用 WIC OnLoad 解码，静态全图缓存上限30。项卸载取消未完成缩略图任务；面板 Unloaded 只取消任务，不清空持久列表。
显式左键点击缩略图请求执行；ListBox SelectionChanged 仅更新索引。自动切换按存在文件和运行子集推进，到尾部循环。
控件初始化订阅执行请求并注册运行前推进钩子；手动点击把路径/索引发布成运行输入后执行工作流；运行中拒绝重复请求；关闭时退订。
PublishRuntimeInput 写 CurrentImagePath/CurrentImageIndex 运行参数并发布以 workflowId 为键的不可变选择快照。
本地 ImageLoadTool 解析 FilePath 资源地址、验证存在后调用 HalImage.CreateFromFile，并产出 OutputImage/GrayImage；底部面板的 ImageInfo.FullImage 并非该工具执行解码入口。
图像列表以 ImageInputSource 为节点状态；增删清引发配置变化；删清取消缩略图、释放 ImageInfo 全图引用并使缓存失效；ToConfig 保存文件资源引用、当前索引、自动切换、运行模式、勾选路径；LoadFromConfig 经资源解析器重建列表并延迟缩略图解码。

inferences: 自研 App 全局预热可能给首次 Task.Run 降低调度延迟，但其效果不能从注释推为实测；与 VM 控件 Loaded 时的专属线程不等价。
自研全图解码入口同步调用 WIC OnLoad；若在 UI 线程首次访问高像素图，可能造成界面停顿。需要受控计时与调用栈证实，不能仅凭源码断言卡死原因。
VM 的 offscreen ImageSource=null 与自研跨实例 LRU 缓存是不同的保留策略；不能直接推断哪方更快或内存更低。
unknowns: VM Apps.Data.ImageData.GetImageDataFromFile/GetImageDataFrom3DFile 的函数体、底层 decoder 缓存与 native 释放策略未在当前证据中恢复。
VM 多来源时 SelectedImage 的具体选项/CheckedImages 恢复与每个流程页面之间的切换全分支仍需继续核；已证实 GetRelatedImageSourceModule 只沿第一 IMAGE 输入而非全图广度搜索。
VM AutoPlay 对运行完成、失败、回绕的完整模块内部状态机与自研自动切换等价性未证实。
本轮未做冷启动、超大图、海量缩略图或长时间滚动的实测；没有性能快慢结论。
vmEvidence.roleHandoff: 框架线持有原版平台面板与主界面联动取证；插件线只追图像源工具专属源码/算法并提出缺失的公共合同；架构恢复角色在主 HTML 中维护已证实连线，审核角色复核跨层结论；交付协调收证据后决定分发，不自动改动他工作树。

vmEvidence.scope: static decompiled VM platform panel vs ImageSource plugin consumer
confirmed: Platform ImageListPanelBase:439-486 reads ImageNumber/ImagePathN from module Params, maintains ObservableCollection<ImageEntity>; 1000-1015 adds paths without decoding full image.

Panel:303-355 thumbnail worker, 1275-1310 only visible indices, 72x52 ImageData.GetImageDataFromFile or raw 3D, caches in ImageEntity.ImageSource; thumbnail is platform panel cache, not ImageSource algorithm preload.

Panel:1314-1359 selection writes CurrentImagePath and calls VmProcedure.Run asynchronously; AutoPlay chooses predecessor so execution advances to selected item by downstream algorithm, exact native step not recovered.
Panel:1611-1668 selected subset writes SelectExecutePic/CancelExecutePic; 1362-1395 work-end refresh reads module CurImagePath.Value; LocalImageListView:208-269 maps ExecuteType=2 and SelectEnable.
Panel:363-375 Unloaded stops thumbnail thread flag and unsubscribes platform events; does not prove ImageSource module buffer release.
unknown: 全格式底层像素解码与色彩转换最终内核
路径缓存跨格式失效和 Reset/重载的完整释放生命周期
宿主 Run All/Run Selected 命令调用者与整流程结束语义
vmEvidence.boundary: 平台 ImageListPanelBase 负责缩略图、选择和 Procedure.Run；原生 ImageSourceModule 已确认读前推进、原图读取入口及 PathCache。72x52 缩略图不等于运行图或预热。未贯通仅限全格式底层内核、全释放链和宿主批量命令。

confirmed: SetParam CurrentImagePath chooses existing list entry; SelectExecutePic inserts into independent execution subset in main-list order
Process advances cursor before read and wraps; failed read consumes position, successful output increments SN
ConvertFileImage delegates original full image decode to MVDMediaProcess; 72x52 platform thumbnail is not run frame
PathCache stores copy until configured limit and cache hit reuses; no LRU in recovered branch
AutoPlay and AutoStop depend on owning procedure run parameters; stop request still publishes current frame
folder watcher marks changes for Process to consume; RefreshImage report updates panel
unknown: full decoder final pixel kernels across all formats
cache invalidation across every format and Reset/reload lifetime
host Run All/Run Selected command caller and whole workflow finish semantics

comparisons.vm: 从当前显示图像所属模块定位关联源；非图源沿每级首个IMAGE输入追溯，并核同父级/当前模块或FrontModules关系，ImageSourceType=1显示。不是全图BFS。
comparisons.ours: 选中节点或BFS上游图像源；多源借用SelectedDisplaySource分支；相机隐藏；子程序解析不到可沿用旧绑定；上方显示源切换未直接重算底部。
comparisons.target: 来源解析返回明确的workflowId/sourceNodeId/reason；查看来源与执行输入分离；子程序只允许经验证的父级来源，找不到显示原因；显示源改变统一触发解析。
comparisons.choice: 借鉴VM显示图像与来源联动、上下文约束；自研明确多输入分支，不照搬仅首IMAGE输入规则。

comparisons.vm: 平台列表读写模块参数，添加删除勾选写回模块。
comparisons.ours: 节点ImageInputSource是事实源，配置保存资源引用；IsForRun的item变化未被事实源订阅，单独勾选保存条件下可能未同步。
comparisons.target: 列表/勾选由源服务命令提交，一次同步配置和修改状态；运行游标与持久配置分开。
comparisons.choice: 保留整改当前节点事实源，不新建第二套管理。

comparisons.vm: 选图写CurrentImagePath并RunCheck后运行所属流程；AutoPlay会先写前一图以配合原生先推进。
comparisons.ours: 显式点击/键盘触发当前工作流；普通SelectionChanged不运行；自动推进成功后执行，但全局回调依赖当前可见面板。
comparisons.target: 执行与推进携带工作流、来源和运行代次；采用同一序列计划决定下一张与结束，UI只显示。
comparisons.choice: 借鉴VM模块拥有原图执行游标；不采用前一图补偿技巧，不退回UI调度。

comparisons.vm: 横向虚拟化、72×52可见区低优先级线程、滚出清ImageSource；原图PathCache另管。
comparisons.ours: 横向虚拟化、WIC100像素、Task.Run+4..16并发、100ms防抖、50张LRU；item还持有已浏览缩略图。
comparisons.target: 保留后台按需模型；按字节及可见窗口制定实际驻留预算；同键合并加载、文件版本失效、切源取消旧代次发布。
comparisons.choice: 借鉴VM移出视口释放的目标，保留可调窗口缓存；不照搬100ms轮询专属线程。

comparisons.vm: ImageSource原生模块ConvertFileImage调用MVDMediaProcess；PathCache拷贝至配置上限；具体像素内核与完整释放未贯通。
comparisons.ours: 实际执行从每节点快照路径到ImageLoadTool.HalImage.CreateFromFile，不是ImageInfo.FullImage那条遗留WIC显示线。
comparisons.target: 测真实工具解码/转换/灰度/统计及显示发布；明确预览与运行不同质量/所有权。
comparisons.choice: 保留工具与平台解耦；不因VM有原生缓存就先增全图缓存或替换解码器。

comparisons.vm: 已证控件Loaded创建工作线程并按需加载，尚无完整启动调用证据可证明全局有或无预热。
comparisons.ours: Splash.Show前设置线程池min8/4，4个Sleep10ms Task并WaitAll；没有图像解码。1783→50是注释预期。
comparisons.target: 分离启动阻塞成本、线程池调度、WIC冷首用和真实原图工具首用；同条件A/B后才决定保留、移后或取消。
comparisons.choice: 自研可验证策略；不预设预热无用，也不把UI结构问题用全量预解码遮盖。

comparisons.vm: 运行子集、自动播放、当前路径均在模块参数中关联。
comparisons.ours: 当前高亮、运行勾选、自动切换、运行模式并存；Unicode图标、部分硬编码颜色、错误与来源信息分散。
comparisons.target: 用节点名/流程名标明当前来源，区分当前查看与运行勾选；空列表、歧义、多源、缺文件给清楚反馈；统一图标/主题/DPI。
comparisons.choice: 保留紧凑面板，先用HTML确认交互，不新增管理页面。
